items.text: Jason Gibbs is a member of the Santa Clarita City Council. He has been a member of the council since 2020 and served as mayor in 2023. According to his campaign, he earned bachelor’s and master’s degrees in mechanical engineering at Cal Poly and works in the aerospace industry. His bio states he has served on the boards of the Boys and Girls Club, the Valley Industry Assn. and the Salvation Army. He says he balanced budgets and supported small businesses on the council. He also says he backed policies to protect the area’s quality of life.

items.text: Gibbs’s campaign platform emphasizes support for law enforcement, border security, education and local control. He also opposes raising taxes. He has said he would seek federal investments to improve the Interstate 5 and Highway 14 corridors and support policies that draw businesses to the district. He calls the U.S. immigration system broken. He says the government should focus on securing the border and removing dangerous criminals. He also supports reducing visa backlogs. He says he supports President Trump’s efforts to strengthen the economy and reduce taxes for working families. He also backs efforts to secure the border and take action against Iran’s funding of terrorist groups and efforts to pursue nuclear weapons.
